_note: Every value is extracted from a claim quote by compute.py, or computed here from values that were.

match_system_musd.basis: the A&M System's share of the match, $ million

match_other_musd.basis: other sources' share of the match, $ million

project_total_musd.basis: the project total the release states, $ million

total_check_musd.basis: grant plus both halves of the match, which equals the stated total

grant_share_of_total_pct.basis: the federal grant as a percent of the project total, rounded to a whole percent

total_pens.basis: pens in all, small plus commercial-scale

small_per_commercial.basis: small pens per commercial-scale pen, a whole number ratio

value: advanced technology feed and production center
component_names.basis: the planned components, in the release's order

ranch_miles_east_word.basis: miles east of Canyon, as the release spells it

ranch_given.basis: year the ranch was given to WT

education_fy24_musd.basis: community project funding for the education facility, fiscal 2024

education_fy26_musd.basis: community project funding for the education facility, fiscal 2026

tx_on_feed_k.basis: cattle on feed September 1st, 2026, 1,000+ capacity feedlots, thousand head

ks_on_feed_k.basis: cattle on feed September 1st, 2026, 1,000+ capacity feedlots, thousand head

ne_on_feed_k.basis: cattle on feed September 1st, 2026, 1,000+ capacity feedlots, thousand head

us_on_feed_k.basis: cattle on feed September 1st, 2026, 1,000+ capacity feedlots, thousand head

tx_share_us_pct.basis: Texas as a percent of the United States total on September 1st, 2026, rounded to a whole percent

tx_share_us_exact.basis: the same share as a fraction, four places

tx_head.basis: Texas cattle on feed in head

us_on_feed_m.basis: United States, million head, one place

agrilife_report.basis: date of the AgriLife Today report

release_date.basis: date of the A&M System release

years_report_to_release.basis: whole years from the 2019 report to the release

tcfa_share_pct.basis: the association's own share of US fed cattle

sun_elevation.basis: solar elevation over Randall County at 6:50 p.m. CDT on the release date, one decimal

sun_azimuth_compass.basis: solar bearing clockwise from north at the same moment, one decimal

sun_engine_az.basis: the same bearing in the engine's frame, az = 180 - bearing

section_musd.basis: one precast bunk section stands for one $4.875 million share, the match's own unit

grant_sections.basis: bunk sections the grant spans, grant over one share

total_sections.basis: bunk sections in the whole project, total over one share

ranch_square_side_m.basis: side in metres of a square of the ranch's area, one acre = 4046.8564224 square metres, rounded to a metre

gift_square_side_m.basis: side in metres of a square of the gift's area, rounded to a metre

ranch_offset_m.basis: about seven miles east, in metres, one mile = 1609.344 m, rounded to a metre

steer_unit_k.basis: a drawing rule, one steer drawn for every 500 thousand head on feed

tx_steers.basis: steers drawn for Texas, 2,500 thousand over 500, exact

us_steers.basis: steers drawn for the United States, 11,163 thousand over 500, rounded half up
